name: Brute-Force QEF Solver
definition: A method for solving the Quadratic Error Function (QEF) by performing a brute-force grid search over the unit cube [0,1]^3 to find the point with the minimum squared distance to a set of planes, rather than using a closed-form linear algebra solution.
summary: Brute-Force QEF Solver finds the minimum squared distance to planes via exhaustive grid search, offering a robust alternative to closed-form solutions when analytical methods are unstable.
